messages:
tom_sales: Heads-up: EU-Health POC asks for completed SIG/CAIQ sections + explicit DSAR + deletion evidence for embeddings and prompt logs. They want a one-page table and an attestation. Deadline: Thu EOD CET.

ana_sec: Got it. I can extract the relevant CAIQ control IDs for data retention, encryption, and access. Quick clarification: do we need to show S3 delete markers or is a signed attestation + purge job log enough?

lee_priv: For GDPR DSAR evidence, customers typically want (1) export package, (2) deletion confirmation with audit log, (3) statement of controller/processor roles. Attestation + purge logs should be fine for POC.

pat_infra: Storage mapping: embeddings -> encrypted-db (eu-west-1), prompts (only if debug enabled) -> ephemeral-store. We can provide sample artifacts: S3 delete marker example, DB row tombstone, and background job run log.

ana_sec: I'll produce a compact CSV mapping to paste into their vendor spreadsheet and attach CAIQ refs.

legal-bot: Reminder: include poc_trial_dpa_addendum_v3 and subprocessors list.

tom_sales: Please keep rows short so procurement can paste into their template. Also need the DPA sentence: "no training use without explicit opt-in."

lee_priv: Suggested DPA clause: "During the POC, Redwood will not use customer telemetry, prompts, or embeddings for model training or improvement unless the customer provides explicit written opt-in. Retention and deletion will follow the POC configuration and DSAR runbook provided."

ana_sec: CSV mapping (compact):
```
telemetry,storage,region,encryption,access,retention_days,deletion_evidence,caiq
embeddings,encrypted-db,eu-west-1,KMS,restricted-acl,30,db-tombstone+job-log,DP-3
prompts(debug only),ephemeral-store,eu-west-1,KMS,limited,7,cron-purge-log,AP-4
request_logs,s3-bucket,eu-west-1,KMS,rbac+audit,21,s3-delete-marker+audit,SC-8
metrics,tsdb,eu-west-1,disk-enc,svc-roles,90,retention-policy-log,CM-2
```

pat_infra: I'll attach example artifacts to the invite: sample delete marker, sample job-log, and a DB tombstone record (sanitized).

ana_sec: I'll draft the CAIQ snippets and a short paragraph attesting to our POC controls.

lee_priv: I'll produce the DSAR runbook bullets and the DPA sentence for paste.

legal-bot: ACTION: attach poc_trial_dpa_addendum_v3 and subprocessors_declaration_v2.

tom_sales: Thank you team. I'll send the one-pager and invite a walkthrough with their security & legal. Tentative slots: Wed 14:00 CET or Thu 09:00 CET.

(edited)
